Name: The Score

Ms. Hill requested the beat to be played during the sessions for "Project Heads", and they ended up taking the beat.

Name:

(prod. Salaam Remi)
Notes: According to Salaam Remi, "Lauryn went through singing a lot of different things [for the chorus], from ‘Never Dreamed You’d Leave In Summer’ to Chaka Khan records to all types of stuff. When she finally hit that ‘ooh la la la,’ that was the hook. During that process, Lauryn probably recorded her 16 bars every day for seven days straight. She came back in every day to redo it, because she’s that level of a perfectionist."
